{{AnimePokémonInfobox |type1=Water |type2=Ground |ball=None |nickname=Whiscash |jnickname=ナマズン |tmnickname=Namazun |image=[[File:Whiscash Mystery Dungeon Red and Blue.png|256px]] |caption=The {{pkmn2|hero}} and [[Partner Pokémon (Mystery Dungeon)|partner]] speak to Whiscash |caught=no |gender=Male |ability={{a|Anticipation}}{{sup/md|SMD}} |pokemonname=Whiscash |prevonum=340 |epnum=Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team and Blue Rescue Team |current=At [[Whiscash Pond]] |media=anime |noevo=incap |anime=yes |java1=[[Kenta Miyake]] |enva1=[[Rodger Parsons]] }} '''Whiscash''' (Japanese: '''ナマズン''' ''Namazun'') is a [[non-player character]] in [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team and Blue Rescue Team|Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team, Blue Rescue Team]] and their [[remake]], [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Rescue Team DX|Rescue Team DX]]. It is implied that Whiscash makes an appearance in {{g|Super Mystery Dungeon}} as well. ==In the games== Whiscash resides in [[Whiscash Pond]] and is first met there. He enjoys telling stories and is the first to tell the {{pkmn2|hero}} and [[Partner Pokémon (Mystery Dungeon)|partner]] of the [[Ninetales legend]]. Whiscash is seen in Whiscash Pond throughout the whole game. He is the wisest Pokémon in [[Pokémon Square]], and the second wisest in the {{mdc|Pokémon world}}, second only to {{mdc|Xatu|1}}. After the ending credits, he gives the player the HM {{m|Dive}}, which enables entrance to [[Stormy Sea]]. He also unlocks [[Solar Cave]], where HMs {{m|Waterfall}} and {{m|Surf}} can be found. A replacement Dive can also be found there. In Pokémon Super Mystery Dungeon, a Whiscash that is likely to be the same is connected with {{OBP|Emolga|Gates to Infinity}}, {{p|Charizard}}, {{p|Seviper}}, {{p|Tyranitar}}, and {{p|Alakazam}}. {{color2|000|Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Rescue Team DX|Rescue Team DX}} |} ==In animation== [[File:Whiscash PMD anime.png|thumb|250px|Whiscash in ''[[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Team Go-Getters Out of the Gate!]]'']] Whiscash appeared in ''[[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Team Go-Getters Out of the Gate!]]''. Like in the {{pkmn|games}}, he resides at Whiscash Pond. Whiscash was first seen trying to comfort a {{p|Pichu}} whose older brother {{p|Pikachu}} had gone missing in [[Sinister Cave]]. He told Pichu that [[Team A.C.T.]] would save Pikachu, but {{OBP|Snubbull|Red and Blue Rescue Team}} told him Team A.C.T. was already on a mission. Just when it seemed there were no other Teams available to rescue Pikachu, the newly formed [[Team Go-Getters]] and [[Team Meanies]] showed up. Whiscash agreed that both Teams should go and rescue Pikachu. ===Voice actors=== {{vatable|color={{water color}}|bordercolor={{ground color light}} |ja=三宅健太 ''[[Kenta Miyake]]'' |en=[[Rodger Parsons]] |fi=Pauli Virta |pt_br=Mauro Castro}} ==Related articles== {{Animespecies|Whiscash}} {{MDcharacters|water|ground}} {{DoubleProjectTag|CharacterDex|Sidegames|characters in the spin-off games.}} [[Category:Pokémon characters]] [[Category:Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red and Blue Rescue Team characters]] [[Category:Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Rescue Team DX characters]] [[Category:Pokémon Super Mystery Dungeon characters]] [[Category:Animation characters (Pokémon)]] [[Category:Male characters (Pokémon)]] [[de:Welsar (Pokémon Mystery Dungeon)]] [[fr:Barbicha/Pokémon Donjon Mystère]] [[it:Whiscash (Squadra Rossa e Squadra Blu)]] [[zh:鲶鱼王（赤青救助队）]]
